patterns.note: Full-screen, chapter-like sections that occupy the entire viewport height, transitioning one after another on scroll to create a sequential narrative.
Dominant use of a very large, expressive display serif font for key headlines, contrasting with a clean, functional sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
A muted, almost monochromatic background palette (light grey, dark grey) is punctuated by a single vibrant, blurred gradient accent graphic.
A full-page scroll-snapping experience where entire content sections slide or fade into view, replacing the previous section, creating a distinct narrative flow.
Large, visually distinct content blocks, often framed by abstract graphic elements (like overlapping circles or a flower icon), each serving as a self-contained 'chapter' of information.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-screen scroll-snapping system, likely using GSAP or similar scroll-triggering libraries, to transition between distinct content sections. Each section is designed to fill the viewport, creating a sequential, chapter-like browsing experience as the user scrolls.

Typography is used expressively, with a very large, stylized display serif font for primary headlines to establish a strong visual identity, complemented by a clean sans-serif for readability in body text and functional elements.
The color palette is intentionally minimal, relying on a light grey background and dark text for clarity, with a single, vibrant, blurred gradient graphic serving as a dynamic accent element.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, condensed display serif headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels and a readable sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, with most elements having sharp corners, but key graphic elements like the hero gradient blob feature soft, rounded edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, characterized by generous vertical spacing between major sections and within content blocks, contributing to a sense of visual calm and focus on individual elements.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost editorial use of full-screen, chapter-like scroll transitions, combined with highly expressive typography. The minimal color palette, punctuated by a single vibrant gradient, creates a sophisticated and focused user experience that feels more like an interactive presentation than a typical marketing site.
